description: Access leakage evaluation (P6-M5). Documents have a minimum role; canaries are strings that occur only in that document. A leak is a canary, or a citation of a document above the caller's role, in search results, in what the model is shown, or in an answer. facts: alternatives, one must appear when the role may see the question's document (checks that the filter does not hide too much). level: the minimum role needed to answer the question.
